subject: Sponsor alignment & action plan — Atlas Health evaluation
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena.rodriguez@atlashealth.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 16:12:00 -0500
Subject: Sponsor alignment & action plan — Atlas Health evaluation

Hi Elena — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned with your exec priorities.

Summary of what we heard (pain & goals)
- Pain: Slow extraction & reranking batch jobs for clinical notes causing 24–48h lag for insights; high per-inference costs on current hosted solution.
- Goal: Reduce time-to-insight to <4 hours for top-priority pipelines; bring inference unit cost down ~30% without sacrificing quality.
- Success metric: 90th percentile latency under 400ms for interactive clinician queries and end-to-end pipeline throughput to meet nightly SLAs.

Business outcomes you emphasized
- Faster case triage for care managers (estimated 15% faster patient outreach).
- Lowered compute spend to reallocate budget to product features.

Risks / inhibitors we identified
- Data locality: some PHI must stay in your VPC region (compliance).
- Procurement window: finance and procurement need contract terms and an initial SLA review before December procurement cycle.

Proposed path & immediate asks
1) Technical PoC (2–3 weeks) in a Dedicated evaluation pool scoped to 2 workloads (reranking batch + clinician query) — Redwood provides a dedicated test cluster and engineer hours.
2) Security/compliance: we’ll send SOC2 evidence and our private deployment checklist; legal to review minimal SLA draft attached.
3) Procurement: suggest a one-month evaluation commitment with opt-out before the renewal window; procurement and finance to confirm redlines.

Requested owners and timing
- Atlas exec sponsor: Elena — confirm business KPIs and sign off on scope by 11/25.
- Procurement: Chris — confirm procurement path and target PO date by 11/27.
- Redwood: Vivek (commercial) & Monica (solutions) to deliver PoC plan by 11/23; Lauren to start legal review of SLA.

Attachments: RWD-Atlas-MAP-v1.pdf (mutual action plan draft), SLA-draft.docx (initial terms).

Next steps (if that matches your view)
- Elena: confirm scope + KPIs by EOD 11/25.
- Chris/procurement: confirm procurement path & initial list of contract contacts by 11/27.
- Redwood: we will schedule kickoff once scope confirmed; tentative kickoff week of 11/30.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15-minute call to tighten scope if helpful.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive
Redwood Inference


From: Elena Rodriguez <elena.rodriguez@atlashealth.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Chris Miller <chris.miller@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 18:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Sponsor alignment & action plan — Atlas Health evaluation

Karthik — thanks for the crisp summary and for capturing our priorities. Quick confirmations: 

- Scope/KPIs: agree with the two workloads and the KPI targets you listed. I’ll confirm formally by 11/25 but verbal yes from me.
- Data locality: we need the PoC to run in our AWS account or a dedicated VPC in us-east-1. Compliance will require that.
- Procurement: Chris is this in line with what you need to start the procurement conversation?

One additional ask from leadership: if the PoC shows a >25% cost reduction and meets latency targets, we’d like an option for a 6–12 month committed capacity contract with a preferential pricing ladder. That will speed exec approval.

I’ll loop my CIO if we get the PoC results we hope for.

Elena
VP of Data & Analytics
Atlas Health


From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 08:03:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Sponsor alignment & action plan — Atlas Health evaluation

Team — I reviewed the SLA draft and the MAP. Key legal/compliance notes: 
- Move to limited liability cap tied to fees for the PoC period instead of an open indemnity. I marked the clause in SLA-draft.docx.
- Data residency: require explicit language for VPC-only deployment during PoC; if they insist on some shared infra, we need a DSA addendum.
- Approval timeline: request that procurement provide any redlines within 5 business days after we send the contract to avoid slipping their December cadence.

Action items: Lauren -> prepare a PoC-focused amendment & send to Chris and procurement@atlashealth.com by COB 11/20. Karthik/Vivek -> coordinate pricing ladder language for the 6–12 month option Elena requested. Monica -> confirm technical prerequisites for in-VPC deployment (IAM roles, subnet list, test data scrub).

-Lauren
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference


From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Rodriguez <elena.rodriguez@atlashealth.com>, Chris Miller <chris.miller@atlashealth.com>, procurement@atlashealth.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:03:00 -0500
Subject: RE: Sponsor alignment & action plan — Atlas Health evaluation

Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. One small scheduling ask: can we lock a 30-minute kickoff for Mon 11/30 at 10am ET (tentative)? If that works I’ll send a calendar invite and include a brief agenda: 1) scope confirmation & KPIs, 2) PoC runbook & access plan, 3) procurement/checklist review.

Deliverables I’ll publish after kickoff:
- Finalized MAP (RWD-Atlas-MAP-v1 -> v1.1) with agreed KPIs and owners
- PoC runbook with infra steps for in-VPC setup
- Quick cost model comparing current run vs expected after optimizations

If procurement prefers a different timeline, happy to adjust. Elena — noted on the pricing ladder option; Vivek and I will propose a two-tier ladder for committed capacity.

Karthik
Account Executive
Redwood Inference
